The Freelancer's Cut is open for early access. Currently, six of the eight mission remakes are available in game, along with several community created levels.

This is a niche game with a lot of complexity and a steep learning curve. I highly recommend checking out the free demo first to see if this game is for you.
https://www.roblox.com/games/740581795/Entry-Point-Freelancers-Cut-Demo

Rejoin the criminal organization of Halcyon in this pack of remastered Entry Point missions. With new tactics, reworked skills, and expanded mission concepts, try your hand at running elaborate covert infiltrations - sneak, bluff, hack, or force your way through any way you can. There are only two rules: Get the job done and don't get caught doing it.
